type.text: Custom oral appliance for obstructive sleep apnea — HCPCS E0486

benefit.requirement: Covered under the UC05 medical DME benefit; prior authorization required.
Sleep-study report; REI/AHI/RDI; G47.33 diagnosis; treating-practitioner order; PAP intolerance or preference documentation; dental candidacy assessment; provider identities; and treatment plan.
UC05 test rule requires the PCP referral chain and an in-network dental sleep provider.
Authorization status and eventual EOB are available through the test payer Patient Access API.
